objective: Publish verified BUKLOD Main browser File/Blob upload fix for Profile→Advertise creative and optional private payment-proof submission to Expo Hosting web ONLY; do not dispatch Android production OTA or change existing app runtime.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified production web Expo Hosting deployment r9d28ba7ik at buklod.expo.app and Android runtime 1.3.2 OTA update 01a1b67f-83aa-7e6c-93d7-ed8f7daa4ba8 were published for source 03e920798cb5e1401fbbc283add39ac8d63ff8db. User reproduces web `Could not submit: expo-file-system.readAsStringAsync is not available on web`. Web-only source fix in PR #564 merged to GitHub main cf8858399702c5bd8fcfb0956d160f9315b93b17 after 3 green GitHub QA workflows including actual browser Blob and native ArrayBuffer functional regression plus web export. No production artifact yet contains this source change.
chosenApproach: Add a single new exact commit title to existing source-SHA/main-only release dispatcher. Map that title to only the unchanged `production_web_deploy.yml`; recorder accepts the title and verifies `Deployment status` final step. Existing EAS env, protected Supabase Main target, production browser export, frozen web RC SHA256 and immutable deployment URL are mandatory.
selectionRationale: Bug only exists in web branch; browser-only release resolves the error without extra credits, Android OTA or native binary changes. Existing protected branch and exact-SHA production pipeline has demonstrated successful web deployment.
alternativeApproaches: Dispatch Android OTA as well: rejected, Android native path remains unchanged and credits would be wasted.
Trigger web from an old SHA: rejected, missing File/Blob fix.
Deploy to Vercel/Classroom/staging: rejected, not authoritative BUKLOD Main host.
Modify Supabase storage policy: rejected, not the source of failure.
